title: Tall whites in suits forming a 'high-speed horse formation'

tellings.quote: So if you saw them when they were out in the desert, say a/4 mile away, when they all turned on their suits, the force fields from around those suits merged into one. And I speak from direct experience, you would swear there was a giant white floating horse coming at you from out in the desert.

related.note: This is the same giant white horse as the Range Four Harry legend in #1, but Hall explains it as the tall whites' suit force fields merging, not a radioactive horse.

Both describe the tall whites' 'high-speed horse formation', in which merging force fields look like one large white shape at Indian Springs in 1965-67. Here the formation joins fields to make a single larger craft, where the story says it is suits merging.

plain: Between 1965 and 1967 on the Indian Springs ranges in Nevada, according to Charles Hall, the "Tall Whites", very tall, pale beings he says he lived alongside, wore suits that gave off force fields, and when a group of them turned the suits on a quarter mile out in the desert, the fields merged into one. Hall, who says he served there with the Air Force, tells Michels from "direct experience" that "you would swear there was a giant white floating horse coming at you," which he offers as the origin of a local horse legend.
